hooks.name: Governance invariant review before stopping
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn, ask it to review changed engine and API files against .kiro/steering/10-governance-invariants.md. Disabled by default because agent-prompt hooks consume credits; enable it while working on src/engine or server.

action.prompt: Run git diff --name-only. For every changed file under src/engine, server or api, check it against every invariant in .kiro/steering/10-governance-invariants.md. Report any invariant that could now be violated, with the file and line, and name the test that should catch it. If none, say so in one line.
